not_applicable: end_state:pcr_plate (the source paper does not determine the exact volumes; composition checked instead)

items.evidence: apiLevel 2.15; all volumes (1–15 µL aspirates, 5/4/1 µL dispenses) are handled by the p20; the 10 µL final volume is well within well capacity; all measured checks pass.
One tip for master mix dispensed with no well contact, then a fresh tip per primer pair and per colony; every tip is dropped (tip_dropped_at_end and no_cross_contamination pass).

The thermocycling comment leaves annealing as a range (55-65 C) and extension as 20-30 s/kb rather than a committed program. Primer is added before template and a 4 µL primer volume assumes a pre-diluted stock, so I cannot call it fully faithful.
Each well gets 5 µL 2x Q5 (1x in 10 µL), 4 µL of its primer pair and 1 µL template; master mix goes in first and template last, as in the paper.
zip(primer_plate.wells(), dest) and zip(colony_plate.wells(), dest) map A1→A1 through H12→H12 for all 96 wells, each used once.
Comments record plate sealing and a program of 98 C initial denaturation, 30 cycles of denature/anneal/extend, 72 C 2 min final extension and a 4 C hold, suited to Q5.

judge.summary: The protocol builds correct 10 µL reactions with sound tip handling and a 1:1 well mapping, and all measured checks pass. Fidelity is failed because the cycling program is stated as ranges and not committed values, and the primer-before-template order and the assumed pre-diluted primer stock are small departures.
